name: letterboxd
title: Letterboxd
description: Search for movies and shows and open them on Letterboxd
author: mohamed3on

commands.name: search
commands.title: Search Movies
commands.subtitle: Letterboxd
commands.description: Search for a movie or show and open it on Letterboxd

preferences.name: tmdbApiKey
preferences.title: TMDB API Key
preferences.description: Letterboxd has no public search API and blocks scraping behind Cloudflare, so search is powered by TMDB (Letterboxd's own data source). Get a free key at themoviedb.org → Settings → API → "API Key (v3 auth)". A v4 Read Access Token works too.

preferences.name: autoOpenSelected
preferences.title: Selected Text
preferences.label: Jump straight to the top result
preferences.description: When you launch the command with text selected, open the top match immediately instead of showing the list. Does not apply to clipboard text.
